diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for node NotReady events
findings: Node marked NotReady due to DiskPressure
Pods evicted from node due to disk pressure

diagnostic_steps.action: Analyze disk usage and identify space consumers

findings: Root cause: Node disk full due to accumulated Docker images and logs
Contributing factor: No automated cleanup of unused Docker images
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: Node disk full due to insufficient cleanup of Docker images and logs

recommendations.rationale: Mark node as unschedulable to prevent new pod placement
Evict all pods from node to enable disk cleanup
Trigger node image update which includes disk cleanup via Azure CLI
Mark node as schedulable after cleanup

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1beta1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: node-disk-cleanup
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          hostPID: true
          containers:
          - name: cleanup
            image: ubuntu:22.04
            command: ['sh', '-c', 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y containerd && crictl rmi --prune && rm -rf /var/log/*.log /tmp/*']
            securityContext:
              privileged: true
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Deploy CronJob for periodic node disk cleanup
Ensure node is schedulable after remediation

remediation_validation: Verify node disk usage dropped below 70%
Check node status returned to Ready
Monitor disk usage over next 24 hours
